name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
hook: Salzburg to Vienna: the prodigy, the operas and the rival Jeopardy always asks about.

facts.label: Salzburg
facts.statement: Mozart was born in Salzburg in 1756 and baptized in its cathedral, for which he wrote the Coronation Mass.

facts.label: Vienna
facts.statement: He lived in Vienna, where his Domgasse house is a museum, and died there in 1791.

facts.label: The Marriage of Figaro
facts.statement: The Marriage of Figaro includes Susanna's aria "Deh vieni, non tardar"; Kathleen Battle sang Susanna.

facts.label: Don Giovanni
facts.statement: Don Giovanni premiered in Prague and opens with the title character pursuing Donna Anna.

facts.label: The Magic Flute
facts.statement: The Magic Flute has the Queen of the Night aria, written for Mozart's sister-in-law, and Tamino's magic flute.

facts.label: the Jupiter Symphony
facts.statement: Symphony No. 41 is nicknamed the Jupiter; No. 38 is the Prague Symphony.

facts.label: Antonio Salieri
facts.statement: Antonio Salieri was the alleged rival who supposedly poisoned Mozart, a rumor fueled by an 1898 Rimsky-Korsakov opera.
